scientific_integrity.known_results_explicitly_excluded: The sharp dimension-three vector-space bound and existence of maximal nets, and the standalone count of 336 smooth cubic equations.
scientific_integrity.new_contribution: Complete enumeration of all maximal all-smooth plane cubic nets over F2, projective equivalence classes and seven-member F2 point spectra.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Geometric regular-sequence smoothness lemma plus exact exhaustive finite enumeration with two standalone checking programs.
scientific_integrity.unproved_limits: No geometric-member smoothness claim, no abstract isomorphism classification of member curves, no independent mathematical review.

scientific_limitations: Projective equivalence is under PGL3(F2), not all birational equivalence.
Only F2-rational members are required smooth; no assertion about all geometric members.

The known maximal projective dimension two was proved earlier by Asgarli, Ghioca and Reichstein (2022/2023); only the complete 864-net/eight-orbit/five-spectrum classification and rational base-point structure are claimed as additional results.
Earlier unindexed equivalent enumerations may exist; external independent audit is unperformed.
title: Complete projective and arithmetic census of smooth plane-cubic nets over \(\mathbf F_2\)
